title: DiagnosticOperationCycleCaller
source_docs: AUTOSAR Blockset/Classic Platform/Basic Software/Diagnostic Event Manager (Dem)/DiagnosticOperationCycleCaller.md
text: Call AUTOSAR Diagnostic Event Manager (Dem) service interface OperationCycle, {Operation} sets operation defined in Dem service interface OperationCycle; {Client port name} sets the name of client port AUTOSAR component uses to call Dem service interface, {Data type for CycleState} sets the to start or stop operation cycles and {Sample time} sets the block sample time. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Client port name
params.values: Name of client port AUTOSAR component uses to call Dem service interface OperationCycle OperationCycle (default) | character vector

params.name: Operation
params.values: Specify operation defined in Dem service interface OperationCycle RestartOperationCycle (default) | SetOperationCycleState | GetOperationCycleState

params.name: Data type for CycleState
params.values: Specify to start or stop operation cycles Enum:Dem_OperationCycleStateType (default)
